This is a standard model for writing USAGE MODELS for tak.

Standard TOC:

  • Overview:
    • Separate docs about how this Model works
    • As many as you want
  • Role eg: "Fighter"- every User Role in this usage model is referred
    • As many subpages as you want
  • Role eg: "Command Post" - every User Role referred

Requirements

  1. "Usage by Role"/ usagemodel guide should describe why and what this tak usagemodel is.
  2. Specifically we want to have guide slides targeted to different Roles within this usagemodel. As fighter, how to use TAK according to this model… and so on. The guide should work as a teaching material, with or without a teacher.
